public_rationale: The condition occurred: Newsom vetoed SB-1047. Later state and federal laws contradict the literal prediction that nobody would continue trying. They do not settle whether the veto discouraged participants or weakened subsequent proposals. Treating this broader warning as disproved solely because another law passed would overstate the evidence.
limitations: A strictly literal reading of 'nobody will bother' is contradicted.
The broader claim concerns an unspecified effect on efforts and perceptions, without a deadline.
The state legislator's announcement is used for enactment, not its promotional judgments about the law.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If SB-1047 does not pass, the view will be that Big Tech always wins, nobody will bother, and future state and federal efforts will suffer.

statement.excerpt: If the bill doesn’t pass, the view will be that Big Tech always wins; nobody will bother. Future state and federal efforts will suffer.
statement.document_title: Why California’s AI Safety Bill should (still) be signed into law - and why that won’t be nearly enough

from_speaker: the view will be that Big Tech always wins
Future state and federal efforts will suffer
our_interpretation: In context, 'pass' means become law, including the governor's approval.
The ordinary reading is that failure would discourage subsequent AI regulation at both state and federal levels. 'Nobody will bother' also expresses a categorical abandonment prediction.
Continued legislation can refute categorical abandonment without establishing whether efforts were weaker than they otherwise would have been.
The speaker supplied no deadline, measure of discouragement, or population whose views would change.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence links SB-1047's failure to widespread perceptions of inevitable technology-industry victory and substantial discouragement or weakening of subsequent state and federal AI regulation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes that the predicted abandonment and broader discouraging effect did not occur. Continued substantive legislative activity contradicts the abandonment component, but alone does not rule out a weaker chilling effect.
